name: עִיר
summary: Ir is named once, in the genealogy of Benjamin, as the father of Shuppim and Huppim (1Ch 7:12). The name is spelled exactly as the noun עִיר, “city”; scripture does not explain it. A few verses earlier the same genealogy lists Iri (עִירִי) among the sons of Bela son of Benjamin (1Ch 7:7), and Ir may be the same man under the shorter form of his name.

evidence.note: וְשֻׁפִּם וְחֻפִּם בְּנֵי עִיר: “and Shuppim and Huppim, sons of Ir”.
עִירִי, Iri, a son of Bela in the same genealogy.
The noun the name is spelled as: Cain was building עִיר, a city.

note: BDB key p.cm.aj gathers 138 tokens by spelling; only 1Ch 7:12 is the name, the rest are the noun. That Ir and Iri are one man is an inference from the two lists, not stated. The Septuagint's alignment has no clear rendering of the name here.
